Table 11. Changes in Body Weight at Week 64 in Study 7 with WEGOVY 25 mg Tablets
| Study 7 (Obesity or Overweight with Comorbidity)
Intention-to-Treat^1 | PLACEBO N = 102 | WEGOVY 25 mg Tablet N = 205
Body Weight |
- Baseline mean (kg) | 104.8 | 106.4
- % change from baseline (LSMean)^3 | -2.4 | -13.6
- % difference from placebo (LSMean) (95% CI)^3 | | -11.2 [-13.6; -8.8]^2

Study 7 was a 64-week trial that enrolled 307 patients with obesity (BMI greater than or equal to 30 kg/m^2) or with overweight (BMI 27-29.9 kg/m^2) and at least one weight-related comorbid condition, such as treated or untreated dyslipidemia or hypertension; patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus were excluded.

The 64-week study (Study 7)enrolled adults with obesity or overweight with a weight-related condition, and the results for WEGOVY 25 mg tablets show a -13.6% change from baseline (LSMean) compared to -2.4% for placebo.
